forum.title: USB over current  issue
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content:
Problem fixed. I set USB\_FS\_OVCR(PG7) pin by mistake.

Thanks,
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I am debugging USB function on STM NUCLEO-H723ZG demo board. I set the USB\_DEVICE Mode as CDC(Virtual Port) mode. USB\_OTG\_HS can as below.

Now I can get the virtual port number on the computer. But the VBUS over current LED (LD7) is always on. It indicates the VBUS over current. But I have configured the EN pin of STMPS2141STR as high (Set PD10/USB\_FS\_PWR\_EN) to disable this fault.

Can anyone please help to check what’s the problem? Thanks,
